verdict.rationale: RUN's docs say payroll can connect with retirement tools to reduce duplicate work, and that employees can manage ADP retirement accounts through the RUN employee portal. Together these show first-party retirement plans tied to payroll, but nothing explicitly says 401(k) contributions are deducted and synced automatically each pay run. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-payroll automatic contribution sync, details on 401(k) plan setup and offering for ops users, independent or hands-on corroboration.
